notes.title: Version 1.74 Update
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Changed deck rule for the first round: a maximum of 3 monsters appear in the first round (previously 4).
[*] Added deck rule during a level: When all the cards in a round are items or treasures, 2 cards are replaced.
[*] Localization changes to dialogue texts and Baguette card description.
[*] Tweaked the difficulty of the 'Wizards tower' levels. 
[*] Small volume changes to sounds effects and music.
[/olist]
